statement: The Labour Party candidate wins the Holborn and St Pancras parliamentary by-election held on 2026-10-08.
resolution: The official declared result for the Holborn and St Pancras by-election of 2026-10-08, published by Camden Council or the UK Parliament website, names the Labour Party candidate as elected.
failure_condition: A candidate other than the Labour Party candidate is elected in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election of 2026-10-08.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Hurricane Isaias makes its first US Gulf Coast landfall between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-15 with maximum sustained winds of at least 96 mph, Category 2 or stronger.

failure_condition: Isaias makes its first US Gulf Coast landfall with maximum sustained winds below 96 mph, or makes no US landfall between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-15.
